parameters.description:
`msg-to-notificationapi` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your NotificationAPI destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own NotificationAPI destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional NotificationAPI destinations bound per enrollment.

Sign in to your NotificationAPI account and open the Environments section of the dashboard to find the Client ID for the environment you want to use. Set it as NOTIFICATIONAPI_CLIENT_ID; the gateway uses it to route this notification to your NotificationAPI project.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment NotificationAPI destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to NotificationAPI sender endpoint
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own NotificationAPI destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

client_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's NotificationAPI client id
